content.title: About
content.content: Easy Mac Cheese Pasta is a ready‑to‑eat meal consisting of pasta pieces coated with a creamy cheese sauce. The single‑serve package cooks in 3‑5 minutes in the microwave or on the stovetop. It is popular for its convenience, mild flavor, and smooth cheese texture.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Easy Mac was first launched in the United States in the 1970s and quickly became a staple for students and busy adults.
The formula includes wheat flour, dried dairy ingredients, and flavor enhancers that give the characteristic cheesy taste.
Various markets offer different cheese variants such as cheddar, mozzarella, and parmesan.
Packaging often includes instructions in several languages, making preparation easy worldwide.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: The pasta provides a quick source of energy through easily digestible carbs.

items.title: Calcium and vitamin D
items.content: The cheese sauce supplies calcium for bone health and small amounts of vitamin D.

items.title: Protein
items.content: The product offers a modest amount of plant‑based protein useful for muscle repair.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: It contains B1, B2, and niacin, which support metabolic processes.

items.title: Convenient and fast preparation
items.content: Quick cooking helps maintain a regular eating schedule without lengthy meal prep.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: The cheese sauce often contains a lot of salt, which may be problematic for hypertension.

items.title: Trans‑fat presence
items.content: Some versions may include partially hydrogenated oils.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: Contains milk, wheat, and sometimes soy—common allergens.

items.title: Calorie dense
items.content: A single serving can provide 300‑400 kcal, so portion control is advisable.

items.title: Low fiber
items.content: The product provides little dietary fiber, offering limited digestive benefits.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Cook the pasta according to the package directions, then stir in the cheese sauce. For added nutrition, mix in vegetables, chicken breast, or ham.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the product in an airtight container and use within 2‑3 days.
